plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 375 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.38751, -127.26026, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 70 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 0 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-40, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2018-11-21, closures 2026-10-16.
R6Q-duck-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-40: about 496 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.07 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
